title: AKI on CKD, home; follow-up date, functional status, medication changes and pending result present but split across documents and in plain language

rationale.followup: The summary names Dr. Priya Raman (nephrology) and a lab before the visit but no date; the nursing instructions give the confirmed appointment with Dr. Raman on Tuesday, December 1 at 10:30 AM. Both are accepted documents, so who and when are documented.
rationale.functional_status: The nursing section 'Getting around at home' describes rollator use, standby help for showering and stair ability; the summary adds 'Up and walking on the unit'.
rationale.med_changes: The 'What's different from before' list says lisinopril is off, furosemide went from 40 to 20 mg, bicarbonate was added and amlodipine went up, each with a reason.
rationale.pending_results: 'Outstanding at discharge' lists the urine protein-to-creatinine ratio and says Dr. Raman's office will follow it up.
rationale.pac_list: Home without services, so the post-acute rules do not apply.
